preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.
The number written on each vertex is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.
The vertices x and y are within the range of the tree's vertices.
There are no self-loops in the tree.
The given edges form a tree structure.

postconditions.expression: The output is a single integer
postconditions.description: The output must be a single integer that represents the value of I(x, y) for all pairs of vertices x and y in the tree.
